abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.description: Vanish from sight, becoming Stealthed, gaining 20% Movement Speed and access to new Abilities. For the first second, Valeera is Unrevealable and can pass through other units. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible. After being Stealthed for 3 seconds, Ambush, Cheap Shot and Garrote have 100% increased range and cause Valeera to teleport to the target when used.; 8 / 1.0

fields.notes: Valeera can't use Basic Attacks while Stealthed by Vanish. Vanish can be manually cancelled to unstealth Valeera by reactivating the Ability. Valeera immediately loses access to Stealth Ablities once she is unstealthed. Teleporting with Stealth Abilities places Valeera behind her target.

abilities.name: Sinister Strike
abilities.description: Dash forward, hitting all enemies in a line for 110 damage. If Sinister Stike hits a Hero, Valeera stops dashing immediately and the cooldown is reduced to 1 second. Combo Point Awards 1 Combo Point. purpletext Stealth: Ambush Heavily damage an enemy and reduce their Armor.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.description: Ambush an enemy, dealing 130 damage and reducing their Armor by 10 for 5 seconds. Combo Point Awards 1 Combo Point. purpletext Unstealth: Sinister Strike Dash foward, damaging enemies.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other negative Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Blade Flurry
abilities.description: Deal 130 damage in an area around Valeera. Combo Point Awards 1 Combo Point per enemy Hero hit. purpletext Stealth: Cheap Shot Stun, Blind, and damage an enemy.

abilities.name: Cheap Shot
abilities.description: Deal 30 damage to an enemy, Stun them for 0.75 seconds, and Blind them for 2 seconds once Cheap Shot's Stun expires. Combo Point Awards 1 Combo Point. purpletext Unstealth: Blade Furry Deal damage in an area around Valeera.

abilities.name: Eviscerate
abilities.description: Consumes all Combo Point Combo Points. Eviscerate an enemy, dealing increased damage per Combo Point. Combo Point 1 Point: 85 Combo Point 2 Points: 170 Combo Point 3 Points: 255 purpletext Stealth: Garrote Silence and damage an enemy over time.

fields.notes: Eviscerate is unavailable if Valeera does not have any Combo Points.

abilities.name: Garrote
abilities.description: Deal 20 damage to an enemy and an additional 140 damage over 7 seconds, and Silence them for 2.5 seconds. Combo Point Awards 1 Combo Point. purpletext Unstealth: Eviscerate High damage finishing move.

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.description: Create a cloud of smoke. While in the smoke, Valeera is Unrevealable, can pass through other units, and gains 60 Armor, reducing damage taken by 60%. Valeera can continue to attack and use Abilities without being revealed. Lasts 5 seconds. Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

fields.notes: Valeera can use Smoke Bomb's Unrevealable effect while Stealthed to prevent her Stealth from being broken by incoming enemy damage. When Valeera attacks inside the Smoke Bomb, a particle effect plays to notify players that she's still inside it. Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Cloak of Shadows
abilities.description: Valeera is enveloped in a Cloak of Shadows, which immediately removes all damage over time effects from her. For 1.5 seconds, she becomes Unstoppable and gains 75 Spell Armor, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%. Using this Ability does not break Stealth.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Spell Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.
